warnings.title: Publication is irreversible
warnings.copy: This will be written to an immutable public canister. It cannot be edited or deleted, only superseded by a new record or withdrawn by revocation.

warnings.title: No personal data
warnings.copy: Do not enter names, email addresses, IP addresses, or private source. On-chain free text is permanent and public.

warnings.title: Private evidence stays off-chain
warnings.copy: Keep private evidence in your own storage; only a digest and a custodian label go on-chain.
